subject_taxonomy.mapping_procedure: Bind actual available fields or a separately reviewed frozen rubric/classifier; label subject and difficulty per record, not by source. Audit at least ceil(N/20) records and report exact agreement counts. Resolve ambiguity/UNKNOWN independently; no classification or sampling in this review.

difficulty_taxonomy.note: source_prior 只是先验,不替代逐条标定;同 source 内难度仍有分布,标定时可上调/下调并记录理由

subject_difficulty_quotas.unit: 1 配额单位 = 1 个核心族代表记录(族内翻译/换数值版本不占额度)
subject_difficulty_quotas.source_layer_caps: See joint_constraints.source_caps and bound parent plan; full-target feasibility requires every source cap to be met exactly.

proposed_adjustments.rationale: Correct the 10-unit arithmetic deficit by adding 5 basic units to each of calculus/analysis and probability/statistics within the existing proposed taxonomy. Proposal only, not user-approved allocations or a claim of actual supply.

family_representative_rule.grouping: All existing variants with the same core solution structure belong to one family, including numerical/symbolic changes, translations and low-text-similarity versions. Exact text or source is not the whole criterion.
family_representative_rule.eligibility: Propagate known core leakage CONFLICT to the whole family; UNKNOWN membership/core/exposure stays quarantined. License/math eligibility and the frozen classification decision precede representative ranking. Preserve all original records and reasons.
family_representative_rule.representative: Among the pre-qualified members of a CLEAR family, select the lowest frozen sort_key; tie by complete raw_record_sha256 then stable source_record_id. Freeze before capacity calculation, not after observing quota failures.
family_representative_rule.counting: One selected representative costs one quota unit. Other members remain in the family ledger and never enter another split/use or count as extra independent training questions.
family_representative_rule.exclusivity: A family and its fixed representative have exactly one source and one subject/difficulty cell. Resolve ambiguous attributions or keep UNKNOWN; do not silently use 'other'.

shortage_rule.rule: Keep the frozen subject/difficulty table and source caps fixed. If max-flow<300, report the exact maximum and unfilled cells; keep GAP and do not execute a full-target selection.
shortage_rule.revision: A proposed redistribution is a new plan version with before/after integer table, reasons, source caps, feasibility receipt and review before selection. It is not a silent transfer or post-hoc retry. Never relabel difficulty/core or replace representatives to force feasibility.
shortage_rule.no_fabrication: No numeric variants, duplicated families, cross-subject padding, external/frozen-set borrowing, cap overrun or unrecorded re-sampling.

post_sampling_bindings: 实际选中清单含:source_record_id、raw_record_sha256、学科/难度标定值与理由、族 ID、代表标志

joint_constraints.variables: x[s,u,d] are nonnegative integers counting unique eligible family representatives.
joint_constraints.eligible_capacity: A[s,u,d] must be computed only after frozen qualification, family grouping, representative choice and exclusive source/subject/difficulty attribution.
constraints: For each s: sum_(u,d) x[s,u,d] <= cap[s]
joint_constraints.feasibility_method: Integer max-flow: source -> 6 source bins (caps) -> 21 subject/difficulty bins (eligible capacities) -> sink (quotas). Require max-flow=300; this checks counts only, not individual evidence or sampling approval.
joint_constraints.source_cap_equality_implication: Because total caps=300=target, any feasible full selection uses every source cap exactly. One exhausted source cannot be compensated by exceeding another source cap.
joint_constraints.unique_attribution: One frozen representative per core family; source is that representative's source, not any other family member's source. No family may count in multiple cells.
joint_constraints.selection_after_feasibility: With frozen cell counts, deterministic rank within each disjoint cell chooses representatives once. The max-flow helper neither reads nor selects any questions; no IID/uniform-random guarantee.

classification_quality.audit_interpretation: Audit sample agreement is a diagnostic only; record its exact numerator/denominator and coverage. It does not certify all labels or authorize sampling. Independently resolve disagreements and UNKNOWN before freezing the selected representatives.
